entities.summary: Árbenz and Agrarian Reform (Decree 900), a transformative movement in Guatemala (1951–1954). Emerged from Decree 900 Land Reform 1952 and October Revolution (1944). Catalyzed CIA Coup Guatemala 1954 and CIA Coup (Operation PBSUCCESS).
